_note: Which source article each season is drafted from. Written down rather than derived, because a title guessed from a season name is a silent way to import the wrong season: 'The Ultimate Fighter 4' and 'The Ultimate Fighter: The Comeback' are the same show, 'Team Cormier vs. Team Sonnen' and 'Team Cormier vs. Team Bisping' are different ones a year apart, and nothing in the naming makes that safe to infer. Every title here was taken from Category:The Ultimate Fighter seasons, which lists exactly forty-four articles for our forty-four seasons, and checked one by one against the season it claims to be.
